title: Load testing (concurrent active users)
proves: On a locally booted API with seeded data, N concurrent logged-in virtual users doing a realistic staff mix (inbox, conversation, contacts, search, dashboard, task create) with think time stay under the error-rate limit and the per-class p95 budgets; prints p50/p95/p99, error rate and throughput per class.
doesNotProve: The sheet target of 500 concurrent users on production-like hardware: a laptop run is a scaled profile (quick 30 users, full 150; p95 judged at budget x3) with k6, API, Postgres and Redis sharing the same cores.
